content: AgentHierarchy: Structured agent classification with Strategy Director, Domain Coordinator, and Helper roles, each with specific responsibilities and token budgets.
ContextWindow: System for managing token usage through progressive loading, hierarchical compression, and lazy evaluation to maximize information density.
TokenBudget: Strict token allocation rules for each agent type that govern operational constraints and context loading behavior.
InformationDensity: Compression technique using symbolic notation, hierarchical structures, and pattern references to maximize fact-to-token ratio.
KnowledgeMesh: Graph-based knowledge representation where atoms of information are connected by typed relationships for efficient retrieval.
EventStream: Asynchronous communication protocol for inter-agent coordination using pub-sub pattern with structured event payloads.
ProgressiveLoading: Technique for loading context in stages with L1 (critical), L2 (supporting), and L3 (background) layers based on task complexity.
PatternVectorEncoding: System for referencing and composing patterns using compact notation and symbolic relationships.
MicroagentArchitecture: Design pattern using ultra-specialized, single-purpose agents with fixed context size for maximum scalability.
